description: LightGBM 5-member ensemble (rdkit2d+morgan_counts) uncertainty, split-conformal intervals and applicability domain on AqSolDB random/scaffold/cluster splits (seeds 0-4) and the two external transfers. All metrics are on test subsets; the sigma scale, conformal quantiles and the AD threshold were fitted on val (or on the random calibration hold-out).

applicability_domain.selection_rule: max Youden J of 'maxsim < t' for flagging |error| > 1 on the pooled val subsets of the random/scaffold/cluster runs (grid 0.20-0.70, step 0.01)
